context_for_next_testing_agent: Timezone handling bug fix verified. All stats endpoints (/api/stats/comparison, /api/stats/weekly, /api/stats/weekly-review, /api/stats/history) now correctly accept local_date parameter. Sessions logged with local_date appear correctly in dashboard stats.

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: Sessions logged on one day were appearing as logged on another day in dashboard stats because backend used UTC date while sessions use client's local date
bug_fix_verification.e2e_test: Full flow tested: Register -> Onboarding -> Log session with local_date -> Verify stats show correct today_sessions count

additional_bug_found_and_fixed.issue: Variable shadowing bug in /api/stats/history endpoint - 'date' variable in loop shadowed 'date' class from datetime module

test_file_updates.test_sessions_crud.py: Updated to handle new API response structure (session wrapped in 'session' key)
test_file_updates.test_new_features.py: Updated to handle new API response structure (session wrapped in 'session' key)

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The /api/stats/history endpoint had a variable shadowing issue where 'date' was used as both a loop variable (line 1218) and as the date class from datetime module (line 1206). Python's scoping rules caused an UnboundLocalError when local_date parameter was provided.
reproduction_steps: 3. Backend logs show: UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'date' where it is not associated with a value
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Renamed loop variable from 'date' to 'current_date' to avoid shadowing the date class
